name: Deep Anointing
description: Anoint an ally's wounded soul to its deepest layer with slow oil-smooth strokes of the healer's force.

name: Residue Banishing
description: Banish the last grey residue of a curse from an ally's soul with a firm sweeping force.

name: Pith Reading
description: Probe to the marrow of a patient's soul and learn exactly which wounds are mortal.

name: Stalwart Tonic
description: Hand a failing ally a stalwart tonic of soul force that firms the soul against the next blow.

name: Soul Reweaving
description: Reweave the frayed fabric of a ruined soul thread by thread into a sound whole in an ally.

name: Plague Unmaking
description: Unmake a spreading plague of the spirit in an ally's soul before it can pass to others.

name: Breath Recall
description: Call back an ally who stopped breathing in the last few moments and seat the soul in the body.

name: Sealed Shell
description: Seal a shell of force round a gravely wounded ally that nothing hostile to the soul can enter.

name: Vast Restoration
description: Restore a soul that has been all but destroyed with a vast sustained flow of the healer's force.

name: Total Cleansing
description: Cleanse an ally's soul of every curse binding and taint in one great and thorough washing.

name: Ember Revival
description: Blow on the last dying ember of a newly stopped ally's soul until it catches and burns again.

name: Healer's Vigil
description: The text's signature vigil in which the healer holds an ally between life and death for as long as the reserve lasts.

name: Mass Restoration
description: Restore every wounded soul within the reach of the healer's field at once up to the ceiling of the healer's tier.

name: Coreward Cleansing
description: Draw a taint from the edge of an ally's soul toward the Core and burn it out there.

name: Soul Quilting
description: Quilt a wide tear in an ally's soul with patches of the healer's Core force sewn in a tight pattern.

name: Anima Reading
description: Read the full shape of a patient's anima from edge to centre and mark every flaw in it.

name: Resolve Fortifying
description: Fortify an ally's resolve with Core force so the ally's will bears the strain of a long rebuilding.

name: Soul Remaking
description: Pull a ruined soul apart to its parts and remake each part before joining them again.

name: Hex Undoing
description: Annul a curse rooted in the deepest layer of an ally's soul by drawing it out by its root.

name: Edge Recall
description: Seize the soul of an ally at the very edge of death and hold it in the body.

name: Everlasting Shell
description: Hold a shell of Core force about a patient that endures as long as the healer stays upright.

name: Resurgent Whole
description: Raise a shattered soul to full wholeness in one resurgent cast that drains the healer's Core.

name: Boundless Cleansing
description: Cleanse every soul in the healer's reach of curse and taint with a single boundless wash of force.

name: Brink Revival
description: Hold the fading soul of an ally on the very brink and force it back into the living body.

name: Cradling Core
description: The text's signature cradle in which the Core holds a failing soul safe while it is rebuilt with force scaled to the Core.

name: Lifelong Mend
description: The text's signature mend that closes a wound of the soul so thoroughly that it never troubles the ally again.

name: Soul Renaissance
description: Remake the souls of an entire host of ruined fighters at once up to the destructive ceiling of the healer's tier.

name: Final Reprieve
description: Open the widest window of return the healer's tier allows and call back every soul that fell within it.
